EC1: 1. Clinically significant microvascular complications: nephropathy [OR] (estimated glomerular filtration rate below 40 ml/min), neuropathy [OR] (especially diagnosed gastroparesis) or severe proliferative retinopathy as judged by the investigator.
EC2: 2. Recent (< 3 months) acute macrovascular event e.g. acute coronary syndrome [OR] or cardiac surgery.
EC4: 4. Severe hypoglycemic episode within 1 month of screening.
EC5: 5. Agents affecting gastric emptying [OR] (Motilium [OR]®, Prandase [OR]®, Victoza [OR]®, Byetta [OR]® and Symlin®) as well as oral anti-diabetic agents (Metformin [OR], SGLT-2 inhibitors [OR] and DPP-4 inhibitors) if [NOT] not at a stable dose for 3 months. Otherwise, these medications are acceptable and will be kept stable during the entire protocol.
EC6: 6. Oral steroids [NOT] [NOT] unless patients present a low stable dose (e.g. 10 mg or less of prednisone [OR] per day or physiological doses, less than 35 mg/day, of hydrocortisone Cortef®). Inhale steroids at stable dose in the last month are acceptable.
EC7: 7. Other serious medical illness likely to interfere with study participation or with the ability to complete the trial by the judgment of the investigator (e.g. unstable psychiatric condition).
EC8: 8. Failure to comply with team's recommendations (e.g. not willing to change pump parameters, follow algorithm's suggestions, etc).
EC9: 9. Living or planned travel outside Montreal (> 1h of driving) area during closed-loop procedures.
